## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 352 captures during May 2021. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes. It should be read alongside the number of images that could not be graded and the number of results assessed as referable.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. A total of 9 captures were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 2.6. The ungradable count and rate are reported separately to show both the number of affected captures and their proportion of the month’s activity. These results identify the images for which grading could not be completed.

## Grading

There were 62 referable results during May 2021. The median lag was 1. This records the midpoint of the reported grading interval and indicates the typical time between capture and grading for the month. Activity, image quality, and grading results should be considered together when reviewing service performance at North City Eye Clinic.
